market_snapshots_precision.name: market_snapshots_precision
market_snapshots_precision.value: (scale("market_snapshots"."price_usd") <= 18 AND abs("market_snapshots"."price_usd") < 1e60::numeric) AND (scale("market_snapshots"."pool_liquidity_usd") <= 18 AND abs("market_snapshots"."pool_liquidity_usd") < 1e60::numeric) AND (scale("market_snapshots"."volume_usd") <= 18 AND abs("market_snapshots"."volume_usd") < 1e60::numeric) AND (scale("market_snapshots"."buy_volume_usd") <= 18 AND abs("market_snapshots"."buy_volume_usd") < 1e60::numeric) AND (scale("market_snapshots"."sell_volume_usd") <= 18 AND abs("market_snapshots"."sell_volume_usd") < 1e60::numeric)

paper_orders_terminal.name: paper_orders_terminal
paper_orders_terminal.value: "orders"."portfolio_id" IS NULL OR ("orders"."status" IN ('FILLED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND "orders"."paper_details" IS NOT NULL)

orders_precision.name: orders_precision
orders_precision.value: (scale("orders"."requested_quantity") <= 18 AND abs("orders"."requested_quantity") < 1e60::numeric) AND (scale("orders"."estimated_fees_usd") <= 18 AND abs("orders"."estimated_fees_usd") < 1e60::numeric) AND (scale("orders"."actual_fees_usd") <= 18 AND abs("orders"."actual_fees_usd") < 1e60::numeric)

orders_valid_times.name: orders_valid_times
orders_valid_times.value: ("orders"."submitted_at" IS NULL OR "orders"."submitted_at" >= "orders"."created_at") AND ("orders"."executed_at" IS NULL OR ("orders"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."executed_at" >= "orders"."submitted_at"))

orders_lifecycle.name: orders_lifecycle
orders_lifecycle.value: ("orders"."status" != 'CREATED' OR ("orders"."submitted_at" IS NULL AND "orders"."executed_at" IS NULL AND "orders"."actual_fees_usd" IS NULL)) AND ("orders"."status" NOT IN ('SUBMITTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'FILLED') OR "orders"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("orders"."status" NOT IN ('PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'FILLED') OR ("orders"."executed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."actual_fees_usd" IS NOT NULL))

paper_position_state.name: paper_position_state
paper_position_state.value: "positions"."portfolio_id" IS NULL OR ("positions"."paper_details" IS NOT NULL AND "positions"."pool_address" IS NOT NULL AND "positions"."paper_state" IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED', 'EXIT_BLOCKED') AND ("positions"."paper_details"->>'quantity')::numeric = "positions"."quantity" AND ("positions"."paper_details"->>'costBasisUsd')::numeric = "positions"."cost_basis_usd" AND "positions"."paper_details"->>'status' = "positions"."paper_state")

positions_precision.name: positions_precision
positions_precision.value: (scale("positions"."quantity") <= 18 AND abs("positions"."quantity") < 1e60::numeric) AND (scale("positions"."average_entry_price_usd") <= 18 AND abs("positions"."average_entry_price_usd") < 1e60::numeric) AND (scale("positions"."cost_basis_usd") <= 18 AND abs("positions"."cost_basis_usd") < 1e60::numeric) AND (scale("positions"."realized_pnl_usd") <= 18 AND abs("positions"."realized_pnl_usd") < 1e60::numeric) AND (scale("positions"."unrealized_pnl_usd") <= 18 AND abs("positions"."unrealized_pnl_usd") < 1e60::numeric)

positions_lifecycle.name: positions_lifecycle
positions_lifecycle.value: ("positions"."status" = 'OPEN' AND "positions"."quantity" > 0 AND "positions"."closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("positions"."status" = 'CLOSED' AND "positions"."quantity" = 0 AND "positions"."closed_at" >= "positions"."opened_at" AND "positions"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)

paper_fill_metadata.name: paper_fill_metadata
paper_fill_metadata.value: "trades"."portfolio_id" IS NULL OR ("trades"."position_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trades"."notional_usd" IS NOT NULL AND "trades"."notional_usd" > 0 AND scale("trades"."notional_usd") <= 18 AND "trades"."notional_usd" < 1e60)

trades_precision.name: trades_precision
trades_precision.value: (scale("trades"."executed_quantity") <= 18 AND abs("trades"."executed_quantity") < 1e60::numeric) AND (scale("trades"."execution_price_usd") <= 18 AND abs("trades"."execution_price_usd") < 1e60::numeric) AND (scale("trades"."fees_usd") <= 18 AND abs("trades"."fees_usd") < 1e60::numeric)

strategy_fixture_candidates_only.name: strategy_fixture_candidates_only
strategy_fixture_candidates_only.value: "strategy_decisions"."outcome" != 'BUY_CANDIDATE' OR ("strategy_decisions"."mode" = 'FIXTURE' AND "strategy_decisions"."opportunity_key" IS NOT NULL AND "strategy_decisions"."signal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "strategy_decisions"."payload"->'candidate' IS NOT NULL AND "strategy_decisions"."payload"->'candidate' != 'null'::jsonb)

paper_portfolio_cash.name: paper_portfolio_cash
paper_portfolio_cash.value: "paper_portfolios"."available_cash_usd" >= 0 AND "paper_portfolios"."reserved_cash_usd" >= 0 AND "paper_portfolios"."equity_usd" >= 0 AND scale("paper_portfolios"."available_cash_usd") <= 18 AND scale("paper_portfolios"."reserved_cash_usd") <= 18 AND scale("paper_portfolios"."equity_usd") <= 18 AND "paper_portfolios"."available_cash_usd" < 1e60 AND "paper_portfolios"."reserved_cash_usd" < 1e60 AND "paper_portfolios"."equity_usd" < 1e60
